checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: fly to Route 10, a party slot free in the Center's PC, into the north grass, saved

events.why: Route 10's Center is a fly point south of the grass.
The catch's summary needs a party slot. The PC refuses a member holding Mail, so this stores the one that holds none (MIMIEN on the mail glitch saves, where the other five hold Mail).
Into the north grass, where Sweet Scent finds Ekans, Spearow and Voltorb.
The RNG checkpoint's hard reset boots from this save, in the grass.

metadata.notes: Starts anywhere outdoors in Kanto, where Fly reaches Route 10 (sevii_story's 06-back-to-cinnabar ends on Cinnabar). The mGBA seed table (rng_seeds_mgba_route10_save.json) was measured from this checkpoint's end save.
